biggest_catch: Variable gig pay (81% of your own rate after the 19% fee) with no guaranteed bookings — and it is cats-only, so the market is narrower than full-service pet platforms.
catches: Cat in a Flat takes a 19% fee from every booking — sitters keep 81% of their set rate.
Sitters set their own rates, so pay is variable with no guaranteed bookings.
Cats only — narrower market than dog/cat platforms; demand is local and seasonal.
Bookings include the Cat in a Flat Guarantee with eligible vet-care reimbursement and 24/7 support — only when booked on-platform.

steps: Join Cat in a Flat free and create your cat-sitter profile.
Pass identity verification (required for every sitter).
Set your own rates for drop-in visits and house sitting; publish your availability calendar.
Offer a free meet & greet; accept booking requests from cat owners.
Complete the visits/stays; Cat in a Flat takes 19% and you keep 81%.
timing: Paid per completed booking via the platform.
